environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6.0), Node v24.19.0, Python 3.14.7, git; branches.py run as a real process through testkit cli-runner from scratch cwd and scratch git repos; worktree of sdlc/S-005a at de9cf46

cases.title: State name is sdlc/state- plus 14 UTC digits under far time zones
cases.given: A scratch git repo with no config
cases.when: branches.py name --repo <repo> --kind state runs under TZ Pacific/Kiritimati, America/Adak, Etc/GMT+12, Etc/GMT-14 and unset
cases.then: Each run exits 0 with one JSON line and empty stderr; the branch is sdlc/state-<14 digits>; the digits are a valid UTC %Y%m%d%H%M%S between two UTC clock reads
cases.expected: sdlc/state- plus the current UTC time in 14 digits, in every TZ
cases.actual: All five runs exit 0; e.g. TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati gave sdlc/state-20261009075249, inside the UTC read window

evidence.title: key output
evidence.inline:
$ TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati python3 branches.py name --repo <repo> --kind state
exit: 0
{"ok": true, "command": "name", "format": "sdlc/{name}", "kind": "state", "branch": "sdlc/state-20261009075249"}
--- stderr (empty)

seeds.title: name returns ref-unsafe verify and attempt names for hostile --profile and --id
seeds.detail: --profile ../x gives sdlc/S-001-v0-../x-0 with exit 0. git check-ref-format refuses it. The same holds for spaces, ~, @{, : and .lock in an id. No requirement bounds the parts, so this is not a refutation.

seeds.title: Integer parts accept unicode digits, whitespace and huge values
seeds.detail: --part ٣, --n １２, --round ' 3' and 9999... are accepted and normalized to ASCII. Two inputs give one branch name. Negative values give names such as sdlc/S-001-attempt--1.

seeds.title: Error text says 'a attempt branch name'
seeds.detail: The missing-part error for the attempt kind reads 'a attempt branch name needs a non-empty n'. The article is wrong before a vowel.
